# Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Detect app, device, and environment problems in .NET MAUI. Inspect battery, storage, memory, thermal state, network, and runtime conditions.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-app-health
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Registration: `UseAppHealth` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I check battery / storage / thermal health in MAUI?
- Device environment report for support screens
- Watch for low battery or offline and react

## Do not use when

- You need crash/ANR reporting — use Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
- You need validated internet / captive portal — use Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
